cases.name: Workspace help
cases.question: What can you help me do here?
cases.answer: I can help you with tasks related to your supply chain analysis in Sentinel. For example, I can run an analysis like supplier delay, inventory coverage, demand forecast, or what-if scenario simulations. I can also look up specific records, review saved analysis snapshots, or help you import relationships into the Supply Chain Map. If you have a specific question or need guidance on a task, just let me know!

cases.name: Published forecast invocation
cases.question: Forecast demand for P0001 at S001
cases.answer: Would you like to discuss the calculation method?
verified: S001 / P0001 has a 14-day forecast of units sold per day from historical origin 2023-12-18. Active method: quantile histogram gradient boosting.
First forecast day 2023-12-19: estimate 108.36 units sold; seasonal-naive baseline 212.00; estimated lower and upper bounds 19.16 to 304.66 units.

Historical final evaluation across 1,400 forecasts: boosting MAE 83.46 and RMSE 106.62 units; seasonal naive MAE 115.26 and RMSE 146.06 units. Empirical interval coverage was 81.9% for boosting and 83.0% for seasonal naive.

The model uses 0.1, 0.5 and 0.9 quantile fits to estimate the lower bound, median and upper bound. The displayed span is intended to cover the central 80% under the model. The median need not equal the midpoint of the bounds. This is a prediction interval for a future observation, and the actual value can fall outside it.

Empirical quantile bounds describe historical forecast uncertainty. Results are from synthetic retail data. Units sold can understate demand, and historical evaluation does not establish live performance.
Publisher-generated synthetic retail data; dates 2022-01-01 through 2024-01-01; 73,100 accepted CSV records. License: CC0: Public Domain.
